report.summary: The report is generally well-sourced. One tag (drhp-p113) is incorrectly placed: the claim about the long-term marketing arrangement is on page 112, not page 113. All other citations accurately support the claims. The table with PAT, EPS, and OCF is correctly split across pages 49, 50, and 177, though each individual tag only covers one column (partial support for the full table). No untagged factual claims were found.
